verifiedScope.proxy: Lifetime novel publication span from Lem's first book, The Astronauts, to the Polish book publication of Fiasco; it is not a claim of uninterrupted work or a complete career bibliography.
verifiedScope.dateDistinctions: Work markers use original Polish book years. A Man from Mars was serialized in 1946 and is outside the book-span bar. Hospital of the Transfiguration was composed in 1948 but published in 1955. Solaris's later English translation was made through an abridged French version. Story collections, essays, criticism, futurology and post-1987 nonfiction are excluded.
verifiedScope.influence: No claim of influence is inferred from chronological overlap.
